# ADR 001: Static site generated by a Python script, published by Pages from Actions

**Status:** accepted, 25 Oct 2026

**Context.** The catalog must be free, rerunnable and correct as repos change.

**Decision.** A small Python generator (one dependency) writes plain HTML; a scheduled and manual workflow fetches the live repos, builds and deploys to GitHub Pages.

**Alternatives.** A static-site framework (more tooling to maintain for little gain); a hand-written page (goes stale); a client-side app calling the API from the browser (rate limits for visitors, slower first paint).

**Consequences.** The site is only as fresh as the last run (daily). Styling is one CSS file.
